items.q: How does Gillett want you to monitor hormones?
items.a: Like a **new car off the assembly line**: baseline panels at puberty, then ~**6-month follow-ups** with shared decisions. Order **total + free T** (or total + **SHBG**) — not testosterone alone.

items.q: What are the lifestyle pillars before supplements or TRT?
items.a: **Diet** (dairy/IGF-1, vitamin D, fiber, EFAs), **exercise** (3–4 vigorous sessions/week; avoid regular vigorous sessions **>1 hour**), **sleep**, **stress**, and **purpose/self-actualization**. Stack: lifestyle → supplements → exogenous hormones last.

items.q: Are extreme vegan or carnivore diets safe in the early 20s?
items.a: Gillett calls pure extremes in **teens/early 20s a horrible idea** — they likely **decrease free androgens**. Late-20s extremes are more tolerable; fiber/microbiome set-point still matters through the 30s.

items.q: Does cutting calories always help testosterone?
items.a: **Context-dependent**: overweight men may gain long-term T benefit (less aromatase adipose); **lean men** often see **SHBG rise**, lower free androgens, and a catabolic bias.

items.q: Should a man in his 20s with normal labs start TRT for aesthetics?
items.a: **Almost never** in the normal **300–900 ng/dL** range (rare exceptions like Kallmann). Risks include fertility suppression, acne, hair loss, mania, lipids, ferritin — needs an **interdisciplinary physician team**.

items.q: What does physiologic TRT dosing look like when indicated?
items.a: About **100–120 mg/week** cypionate/enanthate, divided **2–3×** — not old **200 mg every 2 weeks**. Steady-state ≠ natural pulsatile release; monitor derm, lipids, hematology, fertility, mental status.

items.q: Does creatine cause hair loss via hormones?
items.a: Creatine can slightly raise **total T** and **T→DHT conversion**, but Gillett says **hair loss is not a reason to avoid it** — it brings you toward what you're naturally inclined to have.

items.q: What does oral L-carnitine do for androgens?
items.a: **1–5 g/day** oral (low bioavailability) supports mitochondrial shuttle and **androgen receptor density**. Watch **TMAO** at high dose — garlic allicin, berberine, or microbiome work can offset.

items.q: How do tongkat ali and fadogia fit the stack?
items.a: **Tongkat ali 300–1200 mg** (eurycomanone-standardized) upregulates steroidogenesis; strongest in deficit/low-IGF states. **Fadogia 300 mg/day** (or 600 mg M/W/F) via LH→Leydig path; check liver enzymes.

items.q: Why does Gillett call low-dose tadalafil underrated?
items.a: **2.5–5 mg/day** for prostate health, **halving nocturia** (better GH/T sleep), mild BP drop, and androgen receptor density. Stay ≤**10 mg/day** (cone-vision effects around 20 mg).

items.q: How hard does alcohol hit male hormones?
items.a: Dose-dependent **aromatase ↑** plus **GABAergic LH/FSH suppression**. Cap about **3–4 standard drinks per 2 weeks** — limit frequency, not just volume. Also **7 kcal/g**.

items.q: Do topical hair-loss drugs spare systemic DHT equally?
items.a: **Topical dutasteride** may spare systemic DHT better; **topical finasteride still drops systemic DHT ~30%**. Caffeine/ketoconazole are weak topicals; avoid topical spironolactone in males.
